views.name: customer_monthly_diffs
views.body_sql:
SELECT 
    customer_id AS customer,
    month,
    payment_amount,
    LAG(payment_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS prev_payment_amount,
    payment_amount - LAG(payment_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) AS monthly_diff
FROM (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date) AS month,
        SUM(p.amount) AS payment_amount
    FROM payment p
    JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m', p.payment_date)
)
views.description: calculates the month-over-month payment difference for each customer by comparing each month's payment to the previous month's payment

views.name: customer_avg_diff
views.body_sql:
SELECT customer, AVG(monthly_diff) AS avg_monthly_diff
FROM customer_monthly_diffs
GROUP BY customer
views.description: computes the average of the month-over-month payment differences for each customer
